comparison.timing_role: Observed separate runs; not an isolated speedup claim

method.commit: Whole private passing transactions only; exact fixed interfaces and unchanged quality floors
method.order: Current deficient cells -> bounded existing-vertex family -> bounded constrained cavities

repair.classification_scope: Changed rows source-float AND exact binary-coordinate classifications; untouched rows source-float only. No global exact-Q population claim.

method.acceptance: Strict fresh batch AND scalar source QA, exact signs/star volume, immutable boundary/prefix, mandatory cumulative mean-ratio minimum and local weight improvement; percentage counts are diagnostics. No solver-status authority.
method.movement: Euclidean ball radius half the shortest incident apex-edge length; fixed before solve; strict stored-coordinate displacement norm
method.order: Unique eligible apices sorted by vertex index derived from actual failed interface faces; one pass, refresh complete star/halo before each solve
method.solver: SLSQP; stage1 minimum normalized displacement; stage2 interface .6 deficit plus1e-4 displacement penalty

supervisor.linux_memory: RLIMIT_AS per Linux process, inherited by children; not aggregate RSS

native.scope: Native identity/construction only; not V4 shell admission
